data.title: 英梨梨 · 赶稿深夜的画板前熟睡
data.description: 同人本截稿日前夕的深夜画室里，数位屏还亮着未保存的线稿。精疲力竭的英梨梨摘下厚黑框眼镜搁在数位板旁，趴在桌上沉沉睡去。两根金色的双马尾垂落在地板上。当伦也为她披上外套时，英梨梨小声嘟囔着「笨蛋伦也……」往衣服深处缩了缩，嘴角却微微抿起。
data.action: sleeping on drawing desk, graphics tablet glowing, wearing coat like blanket
data.lighting: glow of digital drawing monitor in darkened studio
data.promptProse: Slumped fast asleep over her cluttered manga drawing desk late at night, Eriri Spencer Sawamura rests beside her glowing graphics tablet. Her twin blonde tails drape across the floor as a warm jacket is draped over her shoulders, her fang subtly showing as she mumbles in her sleep.
data.animaCaption: Eriri sleeping soundly on her messy drawing desk beside her tablet.
